finding.headline: "The In-Law Inspection"
finding.problem: "His mother will watch everything I do with the baby and tell me I'm wrong in front of everyone. I already feel like I'm on trial."
finding.person: New mum about to visit husband's extended family with newborn; dreads unsolicited advice, criticism of her feeding/body, and being told she's "doing it wrong."
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone — "The In-Law Visit Survival Scripts: Protecting Your Peace With Baby."". Verdict: PASSES.
